text.name: Ledyba
text.flavor: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

text.name: Rowlet

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

attacks.name: Wind Shard
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

text.name: Gossifleur
text.flavor: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

text.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.text: Search your deck for a {Fire} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

text.name: Victini

attacks.name: Victory Dive
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

text.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Wintry Call
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Melony cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.text: Attach a {Lightning} Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

text.name: Chinchou
text.flavor: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

text.name: Flaaffy
text.flavor: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

text.name: Tynamo

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

text.flavor: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

text.name: Cutiefly
text.flavor: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

text.name: Bewear

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

text.name: Pangoro

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Shakedown
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

text.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Berserk
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

text.flavor: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

text.name: Smeargle

attacks.name: Live Painting
attacks.text: Reveal any number of basic Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy you revealed in this way.

text.flavor: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
